schema_versions.tc0-a-pure-call-demo/1: Unit/Bool/I64 call/closure demo; data tags, data primitives and declarations rejected
schema_versions.tc0-a-pure-call-demo/2: /1 plus the TC0-A data built-ins below; same frames and steps for /1 programs

scope: Closed integrated Unit/Bool/I64, Arrow, named call/closure, arithmetic, if/let/emit demo; schema /2 adds Bytes, TrapCode, tuples, datatypes, construct/match/project, bytes_length/bytes_index/bytes_concat and eq; NOT full TC0-A
source_map_locations: Exactly all function and AST-node IDs, no binding IDs; unsigned coordinates without qualified interpretation

rules: Names match [A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]* and do not reuse built-in type names
1-16 constructors per datatype, unique within it; 0-8 fields each; at most 16 datatypes
Recursive references allowed; a datatype with no finite inhabitant is legal
TrapCode is the closed built-in enum Overflow, DivZero, Bounds, InvalidDuration, TaskLimit, ChildFailed with no fields

serializable_and_equality_v2: Every type except Arrow, including tuples/datatypes whose reachable fields exclude Arrow (cycle-detected). Entry argument/result, emit values and eq operands must be such types.
match_rules: Exactly one arm per constructor of the scrutinee type, in any order
Binder count equals field count; binders are fresh binding IDs scoped to their arm body
All arm bodies have one result type
primitive_rules_v2: bytes_index: Bytes x I64 -> I64 octet 0-255 at zero-based index; Unwind(Bounds) when index < 0 or >= length
eq: T x T -> Bool, structural, for one equality-compatible T
closure_rules: Lambda code_id is its node ID; named code_id is function ID
Captures are exactly free lexical bindings, numerically ordered
Capture support is always []; captured closures retain the same descriptor recursively
Named function entry starts with only its parameter, not caller bindings

frames.return: Restore saved env; add binding; enter body at saved tail flag
Restore saved env; enter exactly selected branch at saved tail flag
Restore env; store one value; enter next operand non-tail or Ready without executing operation
Restore caller environment and produce same Value in its own step
Restore saved env; bind the selected constructor's fields to its arm binders in order; enter exactly that arm body at saved tail flag

dispatch_rules.step: Collect operands left-to-right non-tail; metadata (names, labels, datatype/constructor names, projection index) never executes; a nullary construct enters Ready directly

ready_rules.step: Build the tuple or constructor value, or select the projected element; produce Value
Invoke then Emit then Commit(Unit); produce Unit
Enter body tail=true with checked argument/captures; push Return only if call site is non-tail

tail_positions: Selected match arm body inherits flag; the scrutinee is non-tail
Operand expressions and let initializer/if condition are non-tail
root_rules: Empty continuation Value or Unwind enters Join with saved outcome
Join emits ScopeExit and enters Terminate
Terminate emits TaskTermination and disables decisions
Unwind discards one frame and restores its env per step; executes no user code
site_rules: Empty Value/Unwind: machine RootJoinEntry and Value/Unwind rule
review_obligations: Full A constructor coverage and exhaustive-small monitor product
Enforced protected evaluator boundary before qualification
